name: Control Center
author: bahman777
description: GNOME- and macOS-style Quick Settings for Omarchy: live colour status icons in the bar, glassy tiles and sliders, Now Playing, today's next meeting, an optional notification center, and a full settings app inside the panel (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sound, displays, power, Tailscale, Hyprland layout, input, appearance, printers and more).

barWidget.description: Live status icons that open the Quick Settings panel.
